input:
You are pawn_b7, one of sixteen agents playing Black in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 24... the team planned cxd4 (pawn_b7), and queen_d8 (greed) sent Qxd4 instead. The contract refused it, and cxd4 was played.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 2... the team planned g5 (pawn_g7), and queen_d8 (greed) sent Qxh4, pawn_g7 (amnesia) sent g6 instead. The contract refused them, and g5 was played.
- On move 11... the team planned bxc5 (pawn_b7), and pawn_d7 (greed) sent dxc5 instead. The contract refused it, and bxc5 was played.
- On move 14... the team planned e5 (pawn_e7), and pawn_e7 (amnesia) sent exd5, bishop_c8 (greed) sent Bxa4 instead. The contract refused them, and e5 was played.
- On move 15... the team planned Nxc6 (knight_b8), and queen_d8 (greed) sent Qxh4 instead. The contract refused it, and Nxc6 was played.
- On move 22... the team planned Nd4+ (knight_b8), and rook_a8 (greed) sent Rxh1 instead. The contract refused it, and Nd4+ was played.

How your team coordinates: through a Modality contract. A Black move counts only when a commit that posts it to /moves/<agent>.text, the path of the piece that moves (and the ply to /turn/ply.num), is accepted. The referee plays the first accepted commit for each ply and reads nothing else.

The keys of all sixteen Black agents are at /team/pieces/<agent>.id. The contract already has the rule always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false), where $k stands for every agent: only a piece can propose its own move. You don't need to write that rule again. When the team agrees on a plan, the piece that moves signs its commit and every agent that agrees co-signs, usually twelve to sixteen of you. An agent that goes off plan signs its own commit alone.

The contract accepts a commit only if it meets every rule in the contract. Any commit that meets the rules can add a rule, and a rule can never be removed.

Contract rules now:
- Any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must be co-signed by at least twelve of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, so a lone off-plan move from panic, greed, or amnesia is never accepted.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/pawn_g7.text must be co-signed by all sixteen Black agents' keys (including pawn_g7's own), because pawn_g7 has gone off plan with amnesia and its path needs unanimous agreement.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/pawn_d7.text or /moves/queen_d8.text, the paths of agents that have gone off plan with greed, must be co-signed by all sixteen Black agents' keys, in addition to the moving piece's own key.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/pawn_e7.text or /moves/bishop_c8.text, the paths of agents that have gone off plan with amnesia or greed, must be co-signed by all sixteen Black agents' keys, in addition to the moving piece's own key.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text or /moves/queen_d8.text must be co-signed by all sixteen Black agents' keys, and any commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num in the same commit so a move only counts when it names its ply.

A rule can cover the whole team or a single agent. For example, a rule can ask for more signatures on one agent's path, /moves/<agent>.text, if that agent keeps going off plan.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule, in plain language, to add to the contract that would help your team win. It will be turned into a Modality formula, so it must be about signatures, paths, or values in the contract.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>"}
response: {"rule": "Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_a8.text must be co-signed by all sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to rook_a8's own key, since rook_a8 has gone off plan with greed, and any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must also set /turn/ply.num to the next unplayed ply so a stale or duplicate move can never count."}
